s: SikaRoof® VersiCell® is a lightweight, high-strength drainage module manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) with cells 30 mm high, providing large internal void volumes for increased drainage discharge capacity. SikaRoof®
VersiCell® forms a hollow space between the structural element and the planting media, providing excellent drainage to prevent flooding of the landscape features.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Drainage layer for intensive green roofs, podium landscapes, planter boxes and retaining wall backfill drainage systems in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the drainage layer.
